serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
???: Oh, you are finally awake.
You: Hello…
???: You were quite lucky. Only a few bruises and a concussion.
You: Lucky, huh…
???: These few days have been a real hell, y’know? This and all the other hospitals in the area are full.
???: Just so you know, we already charged you for the 2 days you spent here.
You: W-what?
???: Doctor will come soon. You are stable and we need the bed for other patients.
You: Is it really ok? 2 days you said, right? I was unconscious for 2 days and you are just kicking me out?
???: Well, that’s how it is. It is an emergency and chances for any deadly complications are very small. Just come here for a checkup if you start bleeding from your ears or having seizures.
You: …
???: Listen, I know that’s probably a very confusing situation for you, but that’s the world we are living in.
???: I can’t force you to get out, but I would have to charge you double if our doctor doesn’t think your stay here is necessary. 
???: So, if you could get up and get your stuff, it would be a big help! Thanks!
???: After all, our hands are full with this guy already.
